glaze-status-write.description: CI's conformance job posting a glaze run. The Worker's secret GLAZE_STATUS_TOKEN; clients read it from GLAZE_STATUS_TOKEN.

golden-read.description: reading the golden image: every machine that pulls. The Worker's secret GOLDEN_TOKEN; clients read it from IRGO_GOLDEN_TOKEN.

golden-write.description: writing, deleting and listing it: only where you push. The Worker's secret GOLDEN_PUSH_TOKEN; clients read it from IRGO_GOLDEN_PUSH_TOKEN.

ledger-read.description: reading the ledger: its page and its JSON. The Worker's secret LEDGER_READ_TOKEN; clients read it from IRGO_LEDGER_READ_TOKEN.

ledger-write.description: the tool posting events to the ledger. The Worker's secret LEDGER_TOKEN; clients read it from IRGO_LEDGER_TOKEN.

info.description: The Cloudflare Worker's API: live glaze status and the private golden image. Generated from the route table in wire/routes.go, the same table the Worker routes by and the clients build URLs from. Every error is an Error whose code is one of: `bad-request` (400): the request is malformed; the message says how; `digest-mismatch` (400): the body did not hash to X-Golden-Sha256; nothing was stored; `unauthorized` (401): no valid bearer token for this route's scope, whatever the path, so a caller without one learns nothing; `not-found` (404): no such route, object, target or key; `method-not-allowed` (405): the path exists, not with this method; Allow lists the ones it has; `conflict` (409): refused against what is stored: an older glaze run, an unreadable record, or an object replaced while being read; `length-required` (411): send Content-Length: R2 stores a stream only of known length; `too-large` (413): the body is over the route's limit; `unsupported-media-type` (415): the body is not the route's media type; `range-not-satisfiable` (416): the Range starts past the end of the object; `internal` (500): a bucket binding is missing, or an answer could not be encoded; `storage` (502): R2 failed, or a write did not read back as written; `not-configured` (503): the secret for this route's scope is not set on the Worker, so it refuses everything.
